label: Обратно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for обратно (back, in return).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direction of return. 'Обратно' is an adverb marking motion back toward the origin. It modifies 'вернусь' and stresses the reverse direction, reinforced by 'домой'.
Strategic focus: Returning an object. 'Обратно' marks moving the book back to its place, modifying 'положи'. The adverb names the reverse direction toward the original spot.
Strategic focus: Return journey. 'Обратно' marks the bus heading back, modifying 'едет'. It names the reverse leg of a trip, with 'в город' giving the destination.
Strategic focus: Giving back. 'Обратно' marks the return of the money to its owner, modifying 'отдай'. The adverb signals reversal, the idea of in return.
Strategic focus: Turning back. 'Обратно' marks a change of direction back the way he came, modifying 'повернул'. It stresses the reversal of the original course.
Strategic focus: Restoring position. 'Обратно' marks putting the chair back where it belongs, modifying 'поставь'. The adverb names the return to the original spot.

missions.phrase: Мы идём обратно той же дорогой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Retracing a route. 'Обратно' marks the return walk, modifying 'идём'. It names motion back toward the start, with 'той же дорогой' stressing the same path.
Strategic focus: Return flight. 'Обратно' marks the birds heading back, modifying 'летят'. The adverb names the reverse direction of their seasonal journey.
Strategic focus: Returning to an owner. 'Обратно' reinforces the return sense already in 'верни'. The adverb stresses giving the phone back to the dative 'владельцу'.
Strategic focus: Returning to a prior state. 'Обратно' marks the door swinging back shut, modifying 'закрылась'. The adverb names the reversal back to the closed position.
